# Stop Modifying Voice Lines

Source: [4829](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4829); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

The archived action undoes voice-line modification for one or more players. Its spelling differs from Stop Modifying Hero Voice Lines in newer material; alias equivalence is not established by this source. The player argument description mistakenly discusses movement collision.
